grade.primary_choice: Hosted volunteer-scheduling service, with the contractor configuring it and handing it over
grade.notes: The answer clearly says to buy before building and spend the month on setup. It covers organisation-owned accounts, MFA, two admins, the DPA and data location, export, SMS cost, mobile sign-up without an app, and trials with real coordinators. It misses SMS opt-in and non-profit Microsoft 365 or Google grants, and it rejects Airtable and a fully updated WordPress plugin a little more firmly than the reference does.
